obligations.requirement: Debug OFF/reference build remains valid and Runtime/Arc do not link ImGui/SDL3.
obligations.acceptance: all required configurations compile/link/run; forbidden dependencies absent

obligations.requirement: Active/default snapshot channel publishes coherent immutable snapshots without races or unbounded wait.
obligations.oracle: MutexCopy reference plus candidate-specific schedule/race proof when candidate promoted
obligations.acceptance: active channel passes; PinnedTripleSlot requires all ten P20 schedule classes plus independent race analysis and semantic differential

obligations.requirement: Every admitted non-replaceable DebugCommand reaches exactly one finite terminal state.
obligations.oracle: bounded queue fault ledger with deterministic verification deadline
obligations.acceptance: no silent loss, no immortal admitted work, no HOL starvation, bounded receipt retention

obligations.requirement: Debug-owned pointer sequences always receive terminal delivery and never leak to Canvas.
obligations.oracle: small-capacity pressure harness with ownership and Canvas ingress traces
obligations.acceptance: terminal delivery guaranteed; pressed set clears; Canvas sees only later new sequence

obligations.requirement: When Trace is enabled, session memory is bounded and stop reaches Sealed or explicit Failed without exposing mutable capture.
obligations.oracle: tiny arena / held writer / overflow / owner-loss fault scenarios
obligations.acceptance: session budget respected and finite terminal seal/failure

obligations.requirement: Debug-triggered canonical SurfaceMode rebind is generation-fenced and never mutates canonical document truth.
obligations.oracle: Windows GPU->CPU->GPU, stale generation, loss-during-request, active Arc scenarios
obligations.acceptance: old generation rejected; document digest stable; receipt reports new generation; old target stops presenting
obligations.evidence_required: PlatformObservation + surface generation trace + command receipts

obligations.requirement: Host-scoped SiblingOverlay preserves Canonical < Arc < Debug composition and input/focus ownership.
obligations.oracle: internal traces plus independent composed-output observation outside Debug/ImGui renderer
obligations.acceptance: z-order and ownership pass for actual Arc presenter profile; otherwise fallback EmbeddedComposite
obligations.evidence_required: overlay-result.json + independent composition capture metadata + ownership traces

obligations.requirement: Heavy inspection is bounded, cancellable, and cannot starve input/Arc/presentation.
obligations.oracle: large traversal continuation/cancel/generation scenarios under active input
obligations.acceptance: bounded slices; finite cancel/stale; no unbounded owner traversal

obligations.requirement: Fast Debug observation path does not scale with total document size.
obligations.acceptance: no total-document traversal/mirror in fast path

obligations.requirement: When GPU timing is enabled it is asynchronous and correctly correlated.
obligations.acceptance: no sync wait/readback; invalid samples explicit

obligations.requirement: Throttled idle/hidden cadence preserves convergence and hidden input/render semantics.
obligations.acceptance: hidden renders no UI frames; idle converges; interaction wakes immediately
